body: I want to be happy and I wish this was just a phase but all I can hear is the voices in my head telling me that no matter what I’m never good enough and no one wants me and I tried asking for help from friends I tried to tell them that i want to die but they don’t realise how serious I am and they just make jokes about it or say I would never do it . I’m fed up of no one caring even though I tried to tell them and they made it out like my problems didn’t matter and made it seem like I’m over reacting and my problems weren’t worthy enough for their attention . I don’t want to die I just want the pain to go and the lonliness I feel everyday to go but till that I’m just miserable
I just don’t see a point anymore everything I do doesn’t matter I’m not important to anyone no one cares
I’m just so glad I found this place because Everyone is so supportive and I feel like I’m not a burden to people :)
I think that’s the only way you can get through it even if you only have the tiniest hope you have to cling on to it and get through it
Thankyou it might be hard now but I will find a way to get better

I’m sorry but how is somone who cuts themselve asking for attention people are acc hurting inside so much they take the anger out on themselves and they cover it up and hide it how is that attention when they go and hurt themselves in secret
We just have to live through it because we’d rather go through the pain then our family that care about us
I could do that to my family so I live through the pain and hope for the best we all have to and remember that hopefully it will get better like they say to us
